verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own API docs cover syncing contact data with other systems, creating and updating records (including custom objects), batch retrieval, and change detection through the webhooks journal API (real-time events, historical event data, object snapshots). The pack has no documented rate limits and no API upsert semantics; email/domain deduplication and the add-or-update import are UI and knowledge-base features, not API upserts. Missing for 10: documented API rate limits, explicit upsert/batch-upsert endpoints, evidence of performance at scale, independent or hands-on corroboration.
